data.narrative:
Mindgrove Technologies is a Series A semiconductor company founded by Shashwath TR and Sharan Srinivas J, having raised ₹85 Cr (~$10M) to date. The target operates within Chips & Semiconductors, a sector with an available comp universe of 11 private peers and 3 public comparables (ALAB, NVDA, AMD). Notable private peers include SambaNova Systems, Cerebras, PsiQuantum, Etched, and Tenstorrent.

The peer-median method is not applicable to this valuation. The Chips & Semiconductors peer set, while containing 11 same-sector companies, lacks sufficient density at narrow filtering levels: only 1 same-stage peer and 1 adjacent-stage peer were identified, falling short of the three-datapoint minimum required for statistical reliability. Applying an all-sector median would introduce unacceptable heterogeneity given the specialized nature of semiconductor venture valuations and their divergent technology trajectories and capital intensity.

Without a sufficiently granular peer-median foundation, this analysis cannot support a triangulated valuation range at this time. Key uncertainties center on the availability of detailed financial or funding data from the top five private comparables—particularly their capital efficiency, burn rate, and revenue traction—which would enable more robust staging assessment. A credible valuation would require either: (1) expanded access to financial metrics from the identified private peer set, or (2) a pivot toward cost-of-capital or discounted-cash-flow frameworks if proprietary company financials become available. Further diligence is recommended before proceeding.
